name: Faisal
buys: Pre-built gaming PCs, RTX 50-series laptops, 240Hz monitors, peripherals
goal: Get the most FPS per riyal and play this weekend
trigger: New GPU launch, a creator's benchmark video, a payday BNPL window
musthaves: GPU/CPU/RAM filters, real benchmarks, Tabby/Tamara split shown on the card, next-day delivery in Riyadh, clear warranty on custom builds
pain: The finder narrows pre-builts but there's no build-your-own; most builds share one image; 'Riyadh: 24 hours' on the product page vs '3 to 7 working days' in the Terms; no reviews
quote: If I have to message three stores to find out when it arrives, I buy from the one that tells me.

name: Reem
buys: Mid-range Windows laptops, MacBook Air, bags, mice
goal: Pick the right laptop for the course without wasting the family's money
trigger: Back-to-school, a professor's spec list, a sibling's recommendation
musthaves: Arabic-first mobile site, 'best for engineering / design / medicine' guidance, monthly price, generous returns
pain: Navigation is by brand, not by need; spec-dump titles; 7-day defects-only returns and 'installment orders can't be returned'
quote: I don't know what an Ultra 7 is. Just tell me if it runs AutoCAD.

name: Abdullah
buys: Dell/HP/Lenovo business laptops in batches of 5–50, printers, servers, docking stations
goal: Get a compliant quote, VAT invoice and delivery to the office this week
trigger: New hires, device refresh cycle, a broken server
musthaves: Request-a-quote, bulk pricing, ZATCA e-invoice, PO / bank transfer, named account manager, on-site warranty handling
pain: No quote page even though a wholesale arm exists (one buyer typed a 2-unit Dell quote into search); only an 'Is company?' box at checkout; contact hours differ by page
quote: I'm not adding 20 laptops to a cart and typing an OTP. Give me a quote.

name: Sara
buys: MacBook Pro / Mac mini, OLED and 4K monitors, docks, storage
goal: Buy the exact configuration with an authorised warranty at a fair price
trigger: Apple launch, client project, an upgrade cycle
musthaves: Exact part number, stock certainty, price parity with Jarir/eXtra, Apple Pay, store pickup
pain: Same MacBook Air M4 is 4,199 SAR here vs 3,999 at Jarir and 3,824 at eXtra; Apple Pay shown in banners but not offered at checkout in Chrome; brand warranties go to the agent
quote: I'll pay a bit more for certainty. I won't pay more for doubt.
